_comment: Per-locale headline copy baked onto the store screenshots — the App Store's by the release (promote.yml),
Google Play's by ci.yml's android-deliver — keyed by the marketing state (test/integration's Shots.kt) each raw in
screenshots/ and screenshots/android/ shows. Version-controlled next to the
rest of the listing, so the copy is reviewable in a PR rather than living only in a CI script.
This file is DELIBERATELY its own. The resolver renders only metadata/listing/ into the stores' files, and
`asc metadata validate` decodes those STRICTLY — an unknown key fails with `json: unknown field "..."`, and
that validation gates the REQUIRED `ci` status check. Google Play's screenshots take the same headlines.
No length limit applies: unlike `keywords` (<=100) these are not Apple fields, and the compositor's
`caption:` word-wraps inside a fixed box, so any copy length fits by construction.
Changing a headline needs NO macOS run — the release re-composites from the committed raws.
